body:
The certificates `rcf` replays for irrational coefficients carry unnormalized polynomials and unreduced field-element expressions, and the kernel redoes the same reductions many times.

Measured on `example : ∃ x : ℝ, x ^ 2 = Real.sqrt 2 ∧ 1 < x ∧ x < 2 := by rcf` (about 14 s of kernel time):

- The quoted data has about 171 field elements and 1256 `mkRat` literals of up to 93 bits. Every element is quoted as `PolyQuot.reduce p root (ofCoeffs #[mkRat …])`, so the kernel performs polynomial division modulo `p` and rational normalisation for every literal.
- `quoteCertificate` in `adapters/HexRCF/RealCoefficients/FieldLiteral.lean` checks the certificate as three separate `decide +kernel` declarations, so the shared literal data is reduced three times.
- Coefficients are not normalised. The carrier polynomial is `(−585248 + 410112√2)/49` times a small polynomial, and its cofactor has numerators around `2³⁸` over `2401`. This growth comes from the field gcd and squarefree computations, which make no polynomial monic and clear no denominators.

To fix:

- Make carrier and chain polynomials monic, or integer-primitive, at every gcd and squarefree step.
- Quote field elements by their already-reduced coordinates, not as `PolyQuot.reduce` applications.
- Check the certificate in one kernel declaration, or otherwise share the reduced literal data between the pieces.

The estimated gain is 1.5 to 2x, independent of the sign-evaluation change in the companion issue.

🤖 Prepared with Claude Code

comments.body:
This is incorporated into the continuing #10358 work. The merged `FieldLiteral.lean` quotes already reduced fixed-field coordinates, shares quoted candidate terms, and provides both combined/split replay controls. Carrier monicization has ordinary-kernel transport laws retaining the original product. The consumed signed-remainder producer uses `Sturm.normalize`, dividing by the **positive absolute** leading coefficient; arbitrarily making negative-leading signed remainders monic would change signs. This does not assert that every intermediate coefficient-field gcd is monic.

The retained [carrier comparison](https://github.com/kim-em/hex-dev/blob/main/reports/hexrcf-carrier-proofs.md) favors normalized carriers on its fixed goals. The [combined-versus-split replay comparison](https://github.com/kim-em/hex-dev/blob/main/reports/hexrcf-replay-proofs.md) did not establish a gain, so combined replay stays off. [#10668](https://github.com/kim-em/hex-dev/pull/10668), squash `77aadd66f60890dd4f5288defad936180c53ea17`, and [#10692](https://github.com/kim-em/hex-dev/pull/10692), squash `73b6a0ecfa41d3586a4327d974e0e5920c314aab`, are merged with green required CI. Their proof-acceptance and literal replay checks use ordinary-kernel proofs, not compiled Boolean evidence.

The retained [sharing/input report](https://github.com/kim-em/hex-dev/blob/main/reports/hexrcf-scaling-proofs.md) and [evidence inventory](https://github.com/kim-em/hex-dev/blob/main/reports/hexrcf-adapter-evidence.md) distinguish unique syntax, expanded references, serialized size and host-specific timings. Reference accounting is not a physical-sharing or executed-work claim. The estimated 1.5–2× general gain is not asserted. #10358 remains open for the complete extension; broader intermediate normalization and generic tower/context replay remain owner/interface work, not silently replaced by the fixed-field carrier result.

Clarification to the earlier summary: direct reduced-coordinate **construction is not the production default**. At current source `805d2ab1135a4ffca23322665729347b77907758`, [`rcf.algebraic.reducedLiterals`](https://github.com/kim-em/hex-dev/blob/805d2ab1135a4ffca23322665729347b77907758/adapters/HexRCF/RealCoefficients/FieldLiteral.lean#L37) defaults to `false`; `fieldExpr` emits `PolyQuot.reduce` over the coordinate literals in that mode. The `PolyQuot.mk` branch with checked degree evidence is a comparison option. The previous phrase “quotes already reduced fixed-field coordinates” referred to the coordinate data and should not be read as eliminating that reduction application by default.

Both retained [literal-quotation comparisons](https://github.com/kim-em/hex-dev/blob/805d2ab1135a4ffca23322665729347b77907758/reports/hexrcf-literal-proofs.md) failed to establish a gain for enabling direct construction. This clarification changes no setting, supplies no new measurement and makes no speedup claim. Carrier normalization, sharing controls and positive absolute-leading-coefficient scaling remain the separate delivered artifacts described above; they do not establish normalization of every intermediate gcd.

#10634 and #10358 remain open for their actual remaining scope. No new issue, PR or downstream worker was created.

title: perf(rcf): normalize polynomials and quote reduced field elements in certificates
